name: Ironclad
description: Let agents read contract workflows, approvals, signature status and signed records in Ironclad, comment on workflows and remind signers. For contract intake triage, chasing signatures, agreement review and finding signed terms.
identity: An Ironclad API app using the client credentials grant. Every call acts as the Ironclad user you name, so agents see and do only what that user may.

setup.title: Create an API app
setup.body: Ironclad shows the API tab only when your company has the API add-on. Create the app in the Ironclad environment your company uses: ironcladapp.com, or eu1.ironcladapp.com for the EU. Ironclad shows the client secret only once.
click: In Ironclad, open your profile menu at the top right > Company Settings > API > Create new app.
Name: {brand.microsoft.appName} > Create app. Copy the client ID and the client secret.

setup.title: Allow the client credentials grant and only the scopes agents need
setup.body: In the app's details, choose the Client Credentials grant and request only the scopes of the capabilities you will give agents. The read scopes are needed for everything.
click: Requested Resource Scopes: the scopes below > Save Changes.

setup.title: Choose the user agents act as
setup.body: Ironclad needs every call to name a user of your company, and answers as that user: agents see only the workflows and records that user can see, and comments and reminders are made in that user's name. Pick a user whose access fits what agents should reach, and enter that user's email in the form.

fields.label: Ironclad address
fields.help: ironcladapp.com, eu1.ironcladapp.com for the EU, or demo.ironcladapp.com for the demo environment. The host name only.

fields.label: Act as user (email)
fields.help: The email of the Ironclad user every call acts as. Agents get that user's access.

capabilities.label: Read workflows and records
capabilities.description: List and read contract workflows, see who still has to approve one, see signature status, and list and read signed records.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches what the user agents act as can see, unless you keep a key to chosen record types.

capabilities.label: Comment on workflows
capabilities.description: Add a comment to a workflow's activity feed, such as a review summary or a question for the requester. It is posted in the name of the user agents act as.

capabilities.label: Remind signers
capabilities.description: Send a signer a reminder email for a workflow already out for signature. Ironclad allows one reminder per signer an hour.

limits.label: Record types
limits.help: Optional: only records of these types, by record type id such as consultingAgreement. Covers listing and reading records, not workflows. Leave empty for every type the user agents act as can see.

revoke: In Ironclad, open your profile menu > Company Settings > API, open the app and reset its client secret. Agents lose access to Ironclad at once.

tools.name: ironclad_list_workflows
tools.description: List contract workflows, most useful with a status, a template or a search. Answers one page; ask for the next page while a page comes back full.

status.description: Only workflows in these statuses. Ironclad lists active ones (Create, Review, Sign and Archive steps) when left out

template.description: Only workflows of this template id

search.description: Words to search for across the workflow's fields, as in Ironclad's own search

filter.description: A filter formula on workflow attributes, such as Equals([counterpartyName], 'Acme Corp.') or GreaterThan([amount], '1000')

last_updated.description: Only workflows updated since this UTC time, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
last_updated.name: lastUpdated

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 100
page_size.name: pageSize

tools.name: ironclad_get_workflow
tools.description: Read one workflow: its step, status, roles and their assignees, and the values of its fields such as counterparty and amount.

id.description: The workflow id or its Ironclad ID, such as IC-1

tools.name: ironclad_list_workflow_approvals
tools.description: List a workflow's approval groups and roles, with who has approved and who is still pending.

id.description: The workflow id or its Ironclad ID

tools.name: ironclad_get_sign_status
tools.description: Read a workflow's signature status: whether the request was sent, and each signer's name, email, role name and status. Only for workflows at the Sign step.

id.description: The workflow id or its Ironclad ID

tools.name: ironclad_list_records
tools.description: List signed contract records, newest agreement first. Answers one page; ask for the next page while a page comes back full.

types.description: Only records of these record type ids, such as consultingAgreement

search.description: Words to search for across the record's properties, as in Ironclad's own search

filter.description: A filter formula on record properties, such as Equals([counterpartyName], 'Acme Corp.')

last_updated.description: Only records updated since this UTC time, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
last_updated.name: lastUpdated

page_size.description: How many per page, at most 100
page_size.name: pageSize

tools.name: ironclad_get_record
tools.description: Read one signed record: its type, properties such as counterparty, dates and amounts, contract status, and linked records.

id.description: The record id or its Ironclad ID, such as IC-1

tools.name: ironclad_add_workflow_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a workflow's activity feed. Mention a user as <@jane.doe@example.com>.

id.description: The workflow id or its Ironclad ID

reply_to.description: The id of a comment to reply to
reply_to.name: repliedToActivityFeedMessageId

tools.name: ironclad_remind_signer
tools.description: Email a signer a reminder to sign a workflow that is out for signature. Name the signer by role name, as ironclad_get_sign_status shows it. One reminder per signer an hour.

id.description: The workflow id or its Ironclad ID

signer_role_name.description: The signer's role name, such as Counterparty Signer
